# Session Handoff Template

> Необязательный шаблон для продолжения между сессиями; используйте нужные поля. Текущие требования — [rules.md](../development/rules.md) и [workflow](../development/workflow.md); Workflow Evidence и Handoff state обязательны только по запросу формального tracked handoff.

Use this when a task spans multiple sessions or another agent needs to continue.

## Workflow Evidence

- Mode:
- Docs read:
- Branch:
- Acceptance criteria or expected behavior:
- Quality gates:
- Commit:
- Handoff state:

## Current Objective

State the active objective.

## Current Status

One of:

- Backlog
- Ready
- Agent Working
- Agent Review
- Human Review
- Done
- Blocked

## Files Changed

- File.

## Decisions Made

- Decision.

## Verification Run

- Command: result.

## Commit

Commit hash, or why no commit was safely possible.

## Known Issues

- Issue.

## Next Step

State the next concrete action.

## Do Not Touch

List unrelated user/agent changes that should not be reverted.
